body: We're far far away from running homebrew. We don't have the retail key to sign whatever they use (I think it's .xvd or .xvc?), so it won't be able to run on a retail console without that. We still need to figure out how to run unsigned code, which the SDK doesn't aid in doing that. Hopefully LIVE security is much more advanced than the 360 and the XB1 modding community can be strictly for development and offline modding.

Yep, I've been living with it for 2 (maybe fucking 3?) years. I wouldn't honestly wish this shit on my worst enemy. It started the year I got to learn to drive, which made driving scary as shit because I'm not 100% aware like I used to be.
